subject: spiritcard
prompt:
STYLE: 2D hand-drawn action comic game art, Chinese ink-wash inspired, bold dark-brown ink outlines (#2B1D16), flat colors with one hard cel-shadow tone, subtle rice-paper texture, slightly chibi proportions (head-to-body 1:3), strong readable silhouettes, ink splatter accents, top-left light source, top-down three-quarter view at 45 degrees, Late Eastern Han dynasty China setting, original designs, suitable for a top-down action roguelike.
Six separate components in strict 3 columns x 2 rows: TOP row three empty vertical bamboo-slip upgrade card frames, common plain wood, rare bronze corners, epic ink-brush and gold corner accents; each has empty portrait center and empty bottom description area, blank red circular seal mount at top. BOTTOM row three detached red circular pictographic seal badges only: dragon blade, tiger spear, bow with arrow. No text, no Chinese characters, no lettering.
Delivery layout: 3 columns x 2 rows. Every cell contains exactly its stated object, optically centered with at least 10% transparent padding. Objects never cross cell boundaries. Use uniform logical cell dimensions. No visible grid, borders or labels. True transparent PNG except ground tiles which must be opaque. Keep rice-paper grain inside painted shapes only; completely transparent empty space, no paper backdrop or matte. Original designs only, no imitation, no watermark or logo.  Target production game sprites, fixed top-left light.
